title: Microsoft Teams: two presenters can share screens or windows at the same time in meetings
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout, default state and administrator recommendations match Microsoft's notice, and the control paths and commands are documented. It distinguishes existing Teams licensing and sharing controls from details that Microsoft has not yet published for simultaneous sharing.

claims.claim: The notice does not name a specific administrator role for its tenant-level control.
claims.quote: Searched: read the complete supplied MC1528014 post for administrator role requirements; it says 'tenant-level admin control' without naming an administrator role.

claims.claim: The notice gives no location for the tenant-level control.
claims.quote: Searched: read the complete supplied MC1528014 post for the tenant-level control's location; it names no admin-center path or command.

claims.claim: No Teams admin center path for the multiple-screenshare setting is documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: 'AllowMultipleScreenshare admin center' and 'Teams multiple screenshare'; opened Manage meeting policies for content sharing and Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy; found the parameter but no corresponding admin-center path.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowMultipleScreenshare $false is a documented meeting-policy command.
claims.quote:
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy
    [[-Identity] <XdsIdentity>]
    [-AllowMultipleScreenshare <Boolean>]
$false: MultiVBSS meeting options are not available (hidden) for the organizer.

claims.claim: AllowMultipleScreenshare controls Multiple Screenshare for the tenant or a particular user through meeting policies.
claims.quote: This setting enables Tenant Admins to turn on the Multiple Screenshare feature. It controls whether Multiple Screenshare is on or off for the entire tenant or for a particular user.

claims.claim: The reference warns that the Multiple Screenshare feature is not fully released and the setting currently has no effect.
claims.quote: This feature has not been fully released yet, so the setting will have no effect.

claims.claim: The reference describes true as making Multiple VBSS meeting options available and enabled for the organiser.
claims.quote: $true: Multiple VBSS (MultiVBSS) meeting options are available and enabled for the organizer.

claims.claim: The reference describes false as hiding MultiVBSS meeting options from the organiser.
claims.quote: $false: MultiVBSS meeting options are not available (hidden) for the organizer.

claims.claim: The reference does not explicitly identify AllowMultipleScreenshare as the tenant-level control described by this roadmap item and notice.
claims.quote: Searched: 'AllowMultipleScreenshare admin center', '80239 Teams', 'MC1528014'; read the parameter description and searched the full reference for both record identifiers; no explicit link to the notice or roadmap item found.

claims.claim: Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Content sharing reaches the documented sharing settings.
claims.quote:
In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies.
Select the policy that you want to edit.
Go to the Content sharing section.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -ScreenSharingMode <value> controls the screen-sharing mode.
claims.quote:
You can also use the Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy cmdlet to control the content sharing settings. Set the following parameters:
- ScreenSharingMode
